_comment: Microsoft 365 Copilot v1 actions (/v1/copilot/*). Default mode is 'entra' and FAILS CLOSED (503) until tenant + audience are set. Tenant = the CLIENT's Entra tenant (tokens are issued by the user's home tenant); audience = the Entra SSO Application ID URI AND Trakt's app GUID (v1 tokens carry the URI, v2 the GUID). See docs/copilot_client_deployment_runbook.md.
name: TRAKT_COPILOT_AUTH_MODE
